desc: WiFi tracking item, superseding archived ticket 139. Firmware staging is DONE offline (done/2026-07-29-t6040-paired-wifi-firmware-builtin.md): Image-macsmc-wifi-fw embeds the exact paired BCM4388 C0/C2 apple,mriya set while retaining SMC and USB storage/usbnet. The remaining gate is PCIe link-up under ticket 124/175. Correction: op-115 is the read half of a plain RMW on a dead PHY-IP aperture, not a PLL-lock poll. CPU-physical shared-PHY addresses are 0x417004000/0x417008000 after the mandatory +0x200000000 /arm-io translation; never use raw ADT bus 0x217... values. Any live PCIe-PHY write is attended-only and separately reviewed.
